connector.name: WizerAPI Review Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Analyze customer reviews: sentiment, emotion, topics, themes, digests, and drafted replies.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.wizerapi.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.wizerapi, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token with your Review Intelligence key (rik_). Free: 100 AU/mo, no card.
